scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducible diagnostic checker provided; historical priority is best-knowledge only, with generic quantizer results identified as overlap risks.
scientific_limitations: Independent synchronous Erlang(k,rate) stages with known integer k, ideal Poisson cohort, one locally designed follow-up, and exact binary classification; no heterogeneous rates, transmission, rate-robust design, observation costs, or field validation. The centroid condition is classical; the claim concerns its Erlang-specific cutoffs and sharp finite-stage asymptotics.
title: Sharp binary-census information in Erlang progression: a universal high-stage offset
